text: Yep, we are trying to figure out how best to add decode paths to Quail. Single or two-token projects (e.g., AI.CLASSIFY) are not so bad because they are still compute-bound. Scheduling gets tricky for open-ended AI MAP operators; we need to mix decode into prefill passes (we can try to "hide" decode under document reading). The challenge here is to be able to accurately estimate the length of an AI MAP operator output; so we can plan well
